import importlib.util, os
for name in ['pypdf', 'pdfplumber', 'fitz', 'pymupdf', 'PIL']:
    spec = importlib.util.find_spec(name)
    print(name, spec.origin if spec else None)
print('workspace', os.listdir('.'))
PY"

/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from pypdf import PdfReader
from pathlib import Path
p = PdfReader('manuscript.pdf')
print('Pages:', len(p.pages))
print('Metadata:', p.metadata)
out = Path('tmp/pdfs')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
texts=[]
for i, page in enumerate(p.pages):
    text=page.extract_text(extraction_mode='layout')
    texts.append(f'\\n\\n===== PAGE {i+1} =====\\n\\n{text}')
(out/'manuscript.txt').write_text(''.join(texts))
print(''.join(texts))
PY"

/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
scratch = Path('tmp/pdfs')
if scratch.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(scratch)
print('Removed temporary PDF extraction and renderings.')
PY"

strengths: The architecture offers a potentially useful integration of persistent low-dimensional memory, top-k patch selection, and associative retrieval into a ViT block.

Table 1 provides encouraging comparisons at similar model sizes: AiT-Small improves CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 accuracy from ViT-Small’s 79.53/53.19 to 83.34/56.30, with 15.8M versus 14.9M parameters. AiT-Medium also outperforms ViT-Base on both datasets using substantially fewer parameters.

The component ablations provide meaningful empirical support. Removing the bottleneck reduces CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 accuracy to 75.40/46.53; replacing Hopfield retrieval with multi-head attention also reduces accuracy. These results support the usefulness of the implemented combination.

Evaluation includes relational reasoning, where AiT improves over Coordination from 73.43 to 76.82. The appendix adds useful diagnostics: disabling test-time memory forward largely preserves CIFAR performance, supporting the usefulness of the stored priors.
weaknesses: The load component of the proposed balance loss is ineffective as written. Equation (5) counts positive entries of A, but the defined softmax attention is positive everywhere, making every load equal to M. If post-top-k attention is intended, the hard indicator has no useful gradient without an unstated estimator. The importance component can still train, but the claimed two-component mechanism is unsupported. No accuracy ablation removes this loss; Figures 9–10 compare training epochs and cannot isolate its contribution to specialization.

The Hopfield formulation does not establish the claimed fundamental distinction from attention. The standard update associated with Equation (7) is equivalent to attention with tied keys and values. Equation (8) specifies an argmin, while the implementation description uses one unspecified iteration; energy reduction does not establish convergence to an attractor in one step. Replacing this operation with general multi-head attention changes its parameterization, so the ablation does not isolate an advantage attributable specifically to energy minimization.

The computational-efficiency claims exceed the evidence. The workspace computes M-by-BN attention scores before top-k selection, and the full architecture retains ordinary per-image self-attention. A fixed bottleneck therefore does not make computation invariant to input quantity or dimension. Parameter-count comparisons support compactness in selected configurations, but no FLOPs, latency, or activation-memory measurements establish the claimed computational savings.

Default inference remains dependent on other examples in the test batch: Section 4.2 computes transient memory from the entire batch even though persistent memory is frozen. Appendix A.5 provides a valuable partial control, but batch-size/composition sensitivity and a training ablation without cross-image squashing are missing. Consequently, the benefits and practical constraints of this central design choice remain insufficiently characterized.

Reproducibility and comparison confidence have additional limitations: Section 5.1 reports a learning rate of 10^-5 whereas Table 6 reports 10^-4, gradient handling across successive memory updates is unspecified, and the principal tables omit variability despite reporting three-run means. These reporting concerns are secondary. The weak-reject recommendation is principally determined by the unresolved balance-loss formulation, retrieval interpretation, and efficiency claims, which outweigh the promising accuracy gains.
